Now I see the issue! Look at `BE32(p)`:

```c
#define BE32(p) (((uint32_t)(p)->hl[0]<<24)|((uint32_t)(p)->hl[1]<<16)| \
```

This reads `p->hl[0]`, `p->hl[1]`, `p->hl[2]`, `p->hl[3]`. These are `uint8_t` values. If `mcopy` copied fewer than 4 bytes, some of these would be zero (from the memset padding). But the `OFFSET_OOB` check ensures at least 4 bytes are available for `FILE_BEFLOAT`. So this is safe.
